messages.subject: Sune | Industrial & Energy Transition Executive | Government Relations, ESG and Global Mobility
messages.body:
Dear Sune,

Your leadership of Pedersen & Partners' global Industrial Practice makes this a focused introduction. I am pursuing senior international mandates where industrial growth, energy transition, government relations and ESG execution intersect.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current remit covers government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, external and corporate affairs, strategic stakeholder engagement and executive communications within a major gold-mining operation.

My portfolio also includes stakeholder governance around approximately 46-50 MWp of solar capacity, more than 80 MWh of battery storage and carbon-data readiness. This gives me direct operating exposure to the institutional and sustainability dimensions of industrial decarbonization.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across External Affairs, Government Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Social Performance and Country Leadership in mining, metals, energy, infrastructure and other industrial sectors. I am internationally mobile and open to Europe, the Middle East and other global markets.

I have attached an industrial and energy-tailored executive CV and would value consideration for current or upcoming searches where this combination fits.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
